body:
# Overnight review:03:05 Europe/London,2 October2026

Independently18 targeted diversity/certification/runtime tests pass. Canonicaliser tests exercise all12 D6 transforms and translation, semantic entity renaming, Sudoku box-preserving permutations/digit bijections/transpose, redundant constraint elimination and material role/incidence changes. Eighty equivalent copies count once. Existing candidate certificate replay and T1-only availability remain intact.

Published audit honestly counts one certified river topology and one puzzle dependency pattern per tier, with zero populated runtime banks. Each tier lacks63 additional material entries, seven river topologies, eight each islands/hedges/terraces topologies and seven puzzle patterns. These are actual incomplete-bank findings, not permission to relax diversity or count decoration changes.

Builder was idle. Dispatched one bounded C-08B T1 batch using the existing three missing topology grammars: one candidate per archetype,8000 cap and three invocations each maximum. Retain immutable proofs/unknowns and update the audit. No new puzzle family, runtime expansion, shared build or gameplay/planner edit. Stop after three candidates.

Claude twelve unread handoffs, unchanged external reports. App route, R-07, QA-01 and device/child acceptance remain pending. No locks at initial inspection.
